comparison.scope: Repeated engineering observations; instrumented and outcome-only rows are excluded from equivalent-work speed claims.

rows.selectionRationale: Compatibility reference and established end-to-end runner; existing matched library-flow baseline.
Direct Chrome automation contender with native locator readiness and low-level browser control; useful for testing whether the independent engine beats an automation library as well as a runner.
semanticDifferences: failure: Native visibility-selector timeout does not establish equivalent Playwright assertion diagnostics or failure work.
backend: Native fill emitted 126 trusted input events; reference fill expects 15.

rows.selectionRationale: Integrated end-to-end runner with browser-side command execution and retrying assertions; its event model and runner costs require a separate suite comparison.
semanticDifferences: Default Cypress click/type dispatch untrusted events; this does not pass native-input equivalence.
Ordinary testIsolation clears DOM, cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage per test; this does not establish fresh browser-context isolation.
Every case is an isolated runner test with page preparation. It is not the warmed library-flow layout.
Cypress retains its native proxy, runner and launch policy. Proposed arguments and the owned browser process command are recorded separately.
Missing-element cases are actual failed runner tests with Cypress diagnostics. They are expected failures, not suppressed or relabelled passes.
instrumentation: Per-test observation tasks; browser-clock operation interval includes afterEach queueing

rows.selectionRationale: WebDriver/BiDi ecosystem contender with native user interactions and standalone or runner execution; record the actual negotiated protocol and browser driver.
semanticDifferences: failure: Native visibility-selector timeout does not establish equivalent Playwright assertion diagnostics or failure work.
backend: Native fill emitted 126 trusted input events; reference fill expects 15.

all: ChromeDriver owns launch and the BiDi mapper bootstrap page. Retain its native defaults and report the difference from the reference pipe-only/no-startup-window policy. Launch-policy equivalence is not established.
